question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_comp_ratio
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IS NOT NULL
      AND month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_comp_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp_ratio DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_comp_ratio as max_index_composition
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
ordered_max AS (
    SELECT 
        mm.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        mm.max_index_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN mm.month_year LIKE '%-2018' THEN 10 + CAST(SUBSTRING(mm.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
                ELSE 22 + CAST(SUBSTRING(mm.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
            END
        ) as month_seq
    FROM monthly_max mm
    JOIN interest_map im ON mm.interest_id = im.id
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_index_composition,
        month_seq,
        AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as prev_month_interest,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as prev_month_composition,
        LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as two_months_ago_interest,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as two_months_ago_composition
    FROM ordered_max
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    ROUND(rolling_avg_3m, 4) as rolling_avg_3m,
    prev_month_interest,
    prev_month_composition,
    two_months_ago_interest,
    two_months_ago_composition
FROM with_lags
ORDER BY month_seq
